text: What are you pretending *not to know*?
What do you keep *almost* saying?
If nothing changed for five more years — would that be *okay*?
Whose approval are you still *writing for*?
What did you love that you quietly *gave up*?
When did you last *surprise* yourself?
What would you stop doing if *no one was watching*?
What question are you avoiding *writing down*?
What do I keep calling fine that *isn't*?
What would I tell a friend who brought me *this*?
If I said it out loud, what would have to *change*?
What did this week actually *cost* me?
What am I hoping someone will finally *notice*?
What am I still doing only because I *started*?
What did I want to say last week that I've already *forgotten*?
Who am I protecting by staying *quiet*?
What would I write if no one would ever *read* it?
What am I calling busy that is actually *avoiding*?
What did I feel this week that I never *named*?
Which version of the story do I tell *myself*?
What's the answer I've never said *out loud*?
What life do I actually want — not the *polished* version?
If the thing I want happened tomorrow, what would I be *afraid* of?
What did I decide this week without noticing I'd *decided*?
Whose voice is in my head when I say I *should*?
What would I stop apologising for if nobody was *keeping score*?
What am I waiting to feel before I let myself *start*?
What did I say yes to this week that my body said *no* to?
Which worry have I carried longest without ever *writing it down*?
